groups.title: Borders
groups.description: Border colors for every interaction state.

tokens.name: border
tokens.description: Border color. Used for most borders, is usually a high contrast color.

tokens.name: border.disabled
tokens.description: Border color. Used for disabled elements, like a disabled input or button.

tokens.name: border.focused
tokens.description: Border color. Used for focused elements, like keyboard focused list item.

tokens.name: border.selected
tokens.description: Border color. Used for selected elements, like an active search filter or selected checkbox.

tokens.name: border.transparent

tokens.name: border.variant

groups.title: Text
groups.description: Foreground colors for UI copy (not syntax).

tokens.name: text
tokens.description: Text Color. Default text color used for most text.

tokens.name: text.accent
tokens.description: Text Color. Color used for emphasis or highlighting certain text, like an active filter or a matched character in a search.

tokens.name: text.disabled
tokens.description: Text Color. Color used for text denoting disabled elements. Typically, the color is faded or grayed out to emphasize the disabled state.

tokens.name: text.muted
tokens.description: Text Color. Color of muted or deemphasized text. It is a subdued version of the standard text color.

tokens.name: text.placeholder
tokens.description: Text Color. Color of the placeholder text typically shown in input fields to guide the user to enter valid data.

groups.title: Icons
groups.description: Icon colors, mirroring the text tokens.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.description: Fill Color. Used for the default fill color of an icon.

tokens.name: icon.accent
tokens.description: Fill Color. Used for the accent fill color of an icon. This might be used to show when a toggleable icon button is selected.

tokens.name: icon.disabled
tokens.description: Fill Color. Used for the disabled fill color of an icon. Disabled states are shown when a user cannot interact with an element, like a icon button.

tokens.name: icon.muted
tokens.description: Fill Color. Used for the muted or deemphasized fill color of an icon. This might be used to show an icon in an inactive pane, or to deemphasize a series of icons to give them less visual weight.

tokens.name: icon.placeholder
tokens.description: Fill Color. Used for the placeholder fill color of an icon. This might be used to show an icon in an input that disappears when the user enters text.

groups.title: Elements
groups.description: Buttons, inputs, checkboxes and other controls.

tokens.name: drop_target.background
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the area that shows where a dragged element will be dropped.

tokens.name: drop_target.border
tokens.description: Border Color. Used for the border that shows where a dragged element will be dropped.

tokens.name: element.active
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the active state of an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on. Active states are triggered by the mouse button being pressed down on an element, or the Return button or other activator being pressed.

tokens.name: element.background
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the background of an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on. Elements might include: Buttons, Inputs, Checkboxes, Radio Buttons... For an element that should have the same background as the surface it's on, use ghost_element_background.

tokens.name: element.disabled
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the disabled state of an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on. Disabled states are shown when a user cannot interact with an element, like a disabled button or input.

tokens.name: element.hover
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the hover state of an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on. Hover states are triggered by the mouse entering an element, or a finger touching an element on a touch screen.

tokens.name: element.selected
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the selected state of an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on. Selected states are triggered by the element being selected (or "activated") by the user. This could include a selected checkbox, a toggleable button that is toggled on, etc.

tokens.name: element.selection_background
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the background of selections in a UI element.

tokens.name: ghost_element.active
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the active state of a ghost element that should have the same background as the surface it's on. Active states are triggered by the mouse button being pressed down on an element, or the Return button or other activator being pressed.

tokens.name: ghost_element.background
tokens.description: Used for the background of a ghost element that should have the same background as the surface it's on. Elements might include: Buttons, Inputs, Checkboxes, Radio Buttons... For an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on, use element_background.

tokens.name: ghost_element.disabled
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the disabled state of a ghost element that should have the same background as the surface it's on. Disabled states are shown when a user cannot interact with an element, like a disabled button or input.

tokens.name: ghost_element.hover
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the hover state of a ghost element that should have the same background as the surface it's on. Hover states are triggered by the mouse entering an element, or a finger touching an element on a touch screen.

tokens.name: ghost_element.selected
tokens.description: Background Color. Used for the selected state of a ghost element that should have the same background as the surface it's on. Selected states are triggered by the element being selected (or "activated") by the user. This could include a selected checkbox, a toggleable button that is toggled on, etc.
